compiler.name: Visual C++ .NET 2003 (cl 13.10.3077)
compiler.notes: The image's linker version is 7.10 and the Rich header records build 3077, the VC7.1 RTM toolset. The exact per-unit optimization, runtime, RTTI, exception and inline flags are not yet proven; every unit must declare its own flags and justify them by matching bytes. A wrapper script can replace 'wine cl' when the toolchain lives in a Wine prefix.
